LanguageData.DespaRIM_Settings_Subtitle: Silence behind a closed door can be a scream too.
LanguageData.DespaRIM_Settings_MoodThreshold_Tip: While a colonist's mood stays BELOW this value, despair builds up inside. As soon as mood rises above it, the counter resets to zero.\n\nRange: 5–40%. Default: 20%.
LanguageData.DespaRIM_Settings_DaysRequired: Days before the break can happen: {0}
LanguageData.DespaRIM_Settings_DaysRequired_Tip: How many consecutive in-game days mood must stay below the threshold before the Despair break becomes possible at all. Until then the chance is zero.\n\nRange: 1–30 days. Default: 10.
LanguageData.DespaRIM_Settings_Mtb_Tip: Mean Time Between: on average, the break fires once every this many days for a colonist who has already passed the threshold. Higher numbers make it rarer.\n\nRange: 10–150 days. Default: 60.
LanguageData.DespaRIM_Settings_Mtb_Daily: ≈ {0} chance of a break for each day after the threshold is passed
LanguageData.DespaRIM_Settings_RescueHours_Tip: How many in-game hours pass between a colonist locking themselves in and their suicide. Break down the door, stun them, down them or arrest them before time runs out.\n\nRange: 0.5–6 h. Default: 2 h (5000 ticks).
LanguageData.DespaRIM_Settings_AllowPrisoners_Tip: If enabled, a prisoner driven to despair can break just like a colonist. They don't look for another room and lock themselves in right in their cell.\n\nDefault: enabled.
LanguageData.DespaRIM_Settings_Summary: Summary: if mood stays below {0} for {1} days in a row, the risk of a break begins (MTB {2} days). Rescue time is {3} h.
LanguageData.DespaRIM_LetterText:
{PAWN_nameDef} had stopped crying and never complained to anyone about anything. One day {PAWN_nameDef} simply got up from the table, food unfinished, and left without a word.

The click of the bolt was barely audible.

This is not a tantrum and not a cry for attention. It is a suicide attempt.

Place: {1}.
You have about {2} h. After that, it will go completely quiet behind that door.
LanguageData.DespaRIM_LetterText_Prisoner:
{PAWN_nameDef} no longer comes to the bars, doesn't ask for food, doesn't look at the wardens, doesn't count the days. The walls of the cell no longer hold {PAWN_objective}: they have become the last thing {PAWN_pronoun} wants to see.

The cell door has been wedged shut from the inside. This is a suicide attempt.

Place: {1}.
You have about {2} h.
LanguageData.DespaRIM_LetterHowToSave: How to save {PAWN_objective}: select a colonist and right-click the locked door to break it down, then bring any colonist right next to {PAWN_objective}. Stunning, downing or arresting {PAWN_objective} also works. If nothing is done, {PAWN_nameDef} will die.
LanguageData.DespaRIM_BreakReason: {PAWN_nameDef} lived with mood below {2} for {1} days in a row. No one noticed when the hope ran out.
LanguageData.DespaRIM_Place_CurrentRoom: the room where despair caught them
LanguageData.DespaRIM_Place_Here: nowhere to hide, right where they stand
LanguageData.DespaRIM_JobReport_Locked: sitting in silence behind a locked door ({0} left).
LanguageData.DespaRIM_MessageLockedIn: {PAWN_nameDef} has bolted the door from the inside. The clock is ticking.
LanguageData.DespaRIM_MessageNoDoor: {PAWN_nameDef} has sunk to the ground and stopped moving. There is no door, but no strength to stand up either. The clock is ticking.
LanguageData.DespaRIM_MessageDoorBroken: The door is broken! {PAWN_nameDef} is still inside. Hurry, get someone next to {PAWN_objective}.
LanguageData.DespaRIM_MessageRescued: {PAWN_nameDef} has come back from the dark. Hard days lie ahead, but {PAWN_pronoun} is alive.
LanguageData.DespaRIM_MessageDied: {PAWN_nameDef} has taken {PAWN_possessive} own life. Nothing can be heard behind the door anymore. The colony will remember that it was too late.
LanguageData.DespaRIM_RescueBy_Talk: {RESCUER_nameDef} sat down beside {PAWN_nameDef} and simply didn't leave. For a long time there was silence, and then {PAWN_pronoun} began to cry.
LanguageData.DespaRIM_RescueBy_Stun: A sharp blow jolted {PAWN_nameDef} out of the stupor.
LanguageData.DespaRIM_RescueBy_Arrest: {PAWN_nameDef} is under guard. Now {PAWN_pronoun} won't be left alone for a minute.
LanguageData.DespaRIM_RescueBy_Downed: {PAWN_nameDef} is drained, but no longer alone.
LanguageData.DespaRIM_Dev_Trigger_Desc: Instantly starts the Despair break on this pawn, skipping the waiting days, mood threshold, MTB and immunity.
LanguageData.DespaRIM_Dev_AlmostOver_Desc: Leaves 10 seconds on the rescue timer, to test the "death" outcome.
LanguageData.DespaRIM_Dev_Status_Desc: Shows mood, accumulated days, immunity and break state. Details are written to the log.
LanguageData.DespaRIM_Debug_NotCandidate: {PAWN_nameDef} cannot fall into despair (not an adult colonist or prisoner, has no mood, or prisoners are disabled in the settings).
LanguageData.DespaRIM_Debug_Failed: {PAWN_nameDef}: could not start the break (asleep and cannot be woken, in a caravan, or already in another state).
LanguageData.DespaRIM_Debug_CounterFilled: {PAWN_nameDef}: low-mood counter filled. MTB rolls start from the next check (if mood is below the threshold).
LanguageData.DespaRIM_Debug_Status: {PAWN_labelShort}: mood {1} (threshold {2}), below threshold {3} of {4} days, immunity: {5}, candidate: {6}, break: {7}
